$comment: The source of sf-radio's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/radio (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

help.summary: The explanation behind a «?» button (sf-help-mark) after the label text: --sf-space-1/4 after the label's last word, on its last line when the label wraps; a press on the button opens it and never changes the control. The help slot takes an sf-help-mark of the page's own.

value.summary: What a checked radio submits; without it, "on", as a native radio (standard 1.3.8 §17.1 item 2).

invalid.summary: The shown invalid state: the error look and aria-invalid on the native input.

change.summary: The selection changed; the native event bubbles from the inner radio, which is its target. The name to bind.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-radio for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.note: error is a dated alias of invalid; the shim maps the attribute and the property
rows.summary: Legacy name of invalid: a dated alias until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json, standard 1.3.8 §17.2).

x-summary: One radio option: a native radio input with a label, description and help text. Radios with the same name form a group in which checking one unchecks the others.
x-decisions: template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (the checked "primary" reference) as a group of three, plus description and help, invalid, disabled and size 2.
css-variables: the six public variables of the class radio (--sf-radio-button-*, the sheet sf-radio draws with) plus one per recolourable state, checked and invalid (§6).
keyboard: the native group's keys: Space selects, ArrowDown/ArrowUp move to the next/previous radio and select it (focus:next, focus:prev); probe.json drives Space and ArrowDown (gate 16).
error -> invalid: §17.2 makes invalid the shown state and error its dated alias (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01).
value defaults to "on", as a native radio (§17.1 item 2; it submitted "" before).

form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals. The inner radio keeps the native group (one checked, arrow keys) under a group key name -- the host form's id or place among document.forms, and the host's name -- and a form attribute naming no form, so it joins no form (§17.1 item 6); its form reset is done by the host (formResetCallback).
size is the enum 1/2, 1, 2 of the class radio sheet.
version 1.1.0: a renamed member behind a dated alias is a minor (§4.10, §16.20).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-11; was a patch 1.1.5 on the branch, never released): the name is the label alone, the description is the description (docs pre-check 2026-11-10 RA-02), through the class binding (component.radio 1.1.1, src/component/checkable-text-helper.js); a slotted description is held in a span with an id. Nothing is drawn differently. Also: the help setting is the explanation, not an icon name (audit 2026-11-11, W1): it draws an sf-help-mark after the label text (size 1/3 beside sizes 1/2 and 1, 1/2 beside size 2; its button named «Подробнее: <label>», word runtime.help), the help slot keeps taking content of its own; it was a decorative aria-hidden icon inside the <label>, so no help existed and a press on it toggled the control. A press that comes from the help (sf-help-mark or what the help slot holds) cancels the label's activation (keepHelpOutOfLabel in src/component/checkable-text-helper.js), the mark stands above the native control's hit area, and pressing it paints no pressed box. The input is named by the label text alone (a slotted label is held in a span), so the help button's name is not part of it; the <label> names its input by `for` (an instance-path id). With component.radio, an icon beside the label (class markup) is the line of its size, as in sf-checkbox (#49); it was 24 at every size (W3). No position setting: the Smart page never promised one; the class markup puts the box at the end by its order (docs «Положение индикатора»). Examples: the help example has an explanation. A minor, not a patch (§4.10): the help setting changes meaning, from an icon name to the explanation text; a page that passed an icon name shows the name as text (journal behaviour-choice-help-text, until 2027-01-01). Also in 1.2.0 (owner remarks 2026-11-11, C59): the help mark is the <label>'s sibling, not inside it: with help the element draws a row (.sf-checkable-row) that holds the <label> and the mark after it, --sf-space-1/4 after the label, centred on the first line, never wrapping alone; pressing «?» presses no control. The hit area is the box and its text: the element's own <label> hugs its content (inline-size: fit-content; max-inline-size: 100%); class markup in C49 rows keeps its full width (component.radio 1.2.0). The name and the description are unchanged. C63 (owner 2026-11-11, audit W5, W6, W9), in the same release: W5, a control with text is a row of its step, (control height - line) / 2 above and below on its own <label>, no gap of its own: 40 at size 1, 60 with a description line, 32 in compact, and under a coarse pointer the step is the touch target max(step, --sf-d1) as the C49 rows; a bare box (no label, no description) stays the box. W6, the label is regular in all three (checkbox and radio drew medium). W9, one shared base: src/smart/helpers/checkable-row.js and checkable-row.css (module.smart-helpers 1.5.0) draw the text column with its help slot, the help mark, the row (.sf-checkable-row) and hold the row's padding, the hit area, the help size and place for the three; the name and description binding is src/component/checkable-text-helper.js for all three (sf-switch had its own copy). The control's <label> carries .sf-checkable, .sf-checkable--size-<size> and, with text, .sf-checkable--text. Journal behaviour-choice-row-step.

version 1.2.0, also (2026-11-12, fix/choice-controls-w): with help and text, the «?» stands right after the name (C59, intent acceptance of the group build 2026-11-12): beside the name's line when the description is longer than the name. The shared row (module.smart-helpers 1.6.0, checkable-row.css) is a grid there; the <label> and its text column hand their parts to it (display: contents) and the label's ::before keeps the hit area the control and its text. The markup, the name, the description and the row heights are unchanged; the «?» stays outside the label.

version 1.2.2 (2026-11-13, dispatcher decision on a C59 standard ambiguity; group build 2 fields-2 acceptance) (the radio bump 1.2.1 rides integration-fix/reds-4; this one stands above it): a patch. When the name wraps, the «?» follows its last word: inline at the end of the last line, --sf-space-1/4 (4) after it, centred on that line -- it stood at the end of the first line, 7-16 px after it and 21-49 after the last word. The shared row (module.smart-helpers 1.6.1, checkable-row.css) holds a place for the mark in the name's own text, glued to the last word, and the mark, still the label's sibling (C59), stands on it by CSS anchor positioning; a browser without anchor positioning keeps the earlier placement. A one-line name is unchanged (4 px after it); a wrapped name takes fewer lines, as the mark no longer narrows every line. Only where the last word and the mark together are wider than the column does the mark take the next line. Markup, settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-radio for one choice in a visible group of mutually exclusive options.
do_not: Do not use Radio for independent choices or immediate binary settings
Do not give related radios different names
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component

getInputElement.summary: Returns the inner native input (.sf-radio-button input[type="radio"]), or null before render.

setChecked.summary: Sets the checked property and state of the inner input; does not dispatch change.

setDisabled.summary: Sets or clears disabled on the host and the inner input.

setState.summary: Applies checked and disabled (checking also refreshes the rest of the named group) to the inner input and reflects them to host attributes; before render it falls back to the base setState.

onChange.summary: Adds a listener for the native change event that bubbles from the inner input.

onFocus.summary: Adds a focusin listener on the host.

onBlur.summary: Adds a focusout listener on the host.
